assumptions: USB-C source is a default (non-PD, non-BC1.2) 5 V source with a 500 mA budget, consistent with the passive 5.1 kOhm Rd-only termination of PWR-002/PWR-005.

ESP32-WROOM-32E peak current is taken as the 500 mA recommended supply capability from the datasheet Recommended Operating Conditions; no duty-cycle averaging of RF transmit bursts is applied, so 528.4 mA is a worst-case peak rather than an average.
CP2102N active supply current is taken as approximately 26 mA from the CP2102N datasheet supply-current specification.

Because an LDO passes load current 1:1, VBUS input current equals the 3.3 V load current plus quiescent; there is no step-down current gain. This is why the 530 mA worst-case VBUS draw exceeds the 500 mA default USB-C allowance.

The VBUS budget failure is a peak-current finding: duty-cycling the ESP32 transmit peak, negotiating higher current, or replacing the LDO with a buck converter all close the budget. As specified today with Rd-only termination it does not close at worst-case peak.
I2C analysis is DC only; bus capacitance is not given, so no fast-mode rise-time result is claimed.
Worst-case +3V3 tolerance uses the LDO datasheet VOUT window (3.234-3.366 V) and does not add further line/load regulation terms.
Capacitor derating is evaluated as applied DC voltage versus rated voltage only; DC-bias capacitance loss is not quantified.
Absolute logic thresholds were not supplied in the design context, so ratiometric CMOS thresholds were used.
No project files were read or modified; all results are closed-form from the supplied pin table, nets, intents and component specifications.
models: Rail voltage model: nominal and worst-case DC levels from datasheet VOUT/VIN min-typ-max; no transient or load-step modelling.
LDO model: series pass element with Iin = Iout (no current gain); regulates while Vin >= Vout + VDROPOUT; dissipation P = (Vin - Vout) x Iout.
Pull-up model: DC resistive pull-up to +3V3; I = Vrail / R while the open-drain driver holds the line low, 0 when released; resistor dissipation P = Vrail^2 / R.
CC sink model: USB Type-C default source presents an 80 uA Rp current source into Rd, so Vcc = 80 uA x 5.1 kOhm.
Rating-margin model: margin_percent = (available - required) / required x 100; resistor current capability derived as sqrt(Prated / R).
Load-budget model: worst-case simultaneous peak currents summed arithmetically with no duty-cycle averaging.
Logic-level model: ratiometric CMOS thresholds (ESP32 VIH = 0.75 x VDD, TMP102 VIH = 0.7 x VDD, VIL = 0.25 x VDD).
